若某正 n 邊形的一內角為該多邊形一外角的 4 倍，則下列何者正確？
I. n 的值為 10。
II. 該多邊形的對角線數目為 10。
III. 該多邊形的旋轉對稱的摺式數目為 10。
A. 只有 I
B. 只有 II
C. 只有 I 及 III
D. 只有 II 及 III
reasoning: Let the exterior angle be e degrees. Then the interior angle is 180‑e. Given 180‑e = 4e → 5e = 180 → e = 36°. Since the sum of exterior angles is 360°, we have 36° = 360°/n → n = 10. Hence statement I is true. The number of diagonals of an n‑gon is n(n‑3)/2; for n=10 this equals 35, not 10, so statement II is false. A regular n‑gon has n rotational symmetries, so statement III is also true. Therefore the correct choice is C.
